descriptions.devops-pro-linux-docker-kubernetes-ci-cd: This Specialization from KodeKloud is currently in progress, covering Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.
descriptions.ibm-introduction-to-data-science: This Specialization from IBM is currently in progress, covering foundational data science concepts, tools, methodologies, and SQL databases with Python.
descriptions.google-project-management: This Professional Certificate from Google is earned after completing all 7 courses covering traditional and agile project management.
descriptions.applied-cryptography: This Specialization from University of Colorado System is earned after completing all 4 courses in Applied Cryptography.
descriptions.ibm-ai-foundations-for-everyone: This Specialization from IBM is earned after completing all 4 courses covering the foundations of Artificial Intelligence (AI).
descriptions.ibm-devops-software-engineering: This Professional Certificate from IBM is earned after completing all 15 courses in DevOps and Software Engineering.
descriptions.ibm-machine-learning: This Professional Certificate from IBM is earned after completing all 6 courses in Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
descriptions.ibm-introduction-to-machine-learning: This Specialization from IBM is earned after completing all 4 courses covering the fundamentals of Machine Learning.
descriptions.pimnas-peserta: Official certificate of participation as a Finalist / Participant in the 38th National Student Scientific Week (PIMNAS) by Kemdiktisaintek and Belmawa.
descriptions.pimnas-pendanaan: Award certificate for securing funding in the Student Creativity Program for Innovative Works (PKM-KI) 2025 by Kemdiktisaintek and Belmawa.
descriptions.bnsp-web-developer: Official Certificate of Competence from the National Professional Certification Agency (BNSP) through LSP Universitas Dian Nuswantoro in the Web Developer scheme.
descriptions.bnsp-junior-mobile-programmer: Official Certificate of Competence from the National Professional Certification Agency (BNSP) through LSP Universitas Dian Nuswantoro in the Junior Mobile Programmer scheme.
descriptions.apti-pemrograman-web: Professional Competency Certificate from the Indonesian Telematics Professional Association (APTI) through LSP Universitas Dian Nuswantoro for skill standardization in Web Programming.
